framework_findings: The wave-1 in_bsnd infrastructure extends to structurally-identical expert kernels at a marginal cost of 5 line-scoped edits per kernel + 3 host edits TOTAL (name-list extension + 2 spec-builder kwargs): the dual-alignment gate, chain_key, _run.in_bsnd capability, adapter resolve-then-supply reorder and _prefill_run_padded passthrough required ZERO changes — the capability-flag + name-list pattern's marginal cost decreases with each domain added (the input-side echo of iter9 finding 6). 11/20 bench cases are now single-kernel chains (BSND in -> BSND out, zero aux launches).

At ns==1 the batched-parity K/V loads' else-branch is dead-eliminated by the compiler SYMMETRICALLY in both arms (the loop provably runs i==0 only) — generated-code box censuses are a function of ns, not source constants; codegen-audit expectations must be ns-aware. The symmetry makes it mechanism-neutral (and it is pre-existing shipped behavior).

Strided-load cost visibility depends on the pipeline structure: the flat steady-state domain absorbed it almost entirely (wave-1 Δmain 0.5-2.6%, realization 92-103%) and the single-batch c19 absorbed it COMPLETELY (Δmain +0.06%, realization 99.9%), while the ns-batch alternating kernels (c8/c9/c10) exposed part of it as Δmain +1.2..+1.7% (realization 78-84%) — batch alternation (GEMM1 batch must complete before GEMM2) gives the strided K-load increment more critical-path exposure than the flattened steady state. The wait-id fingerprint confirms benign absorption, not cadence migration: batch pacers C-id2/V-id4 flat (±2.3%), V-id0 up / C-id5 down compensating within the unchanged cadence.

The full-tqkv-benefit economic model is now calibrated THREE times (write-side wave-1/2, read-side wave-1, read-side wave-2): c19 predicted 33.0 measured 33.41 (+0.4pp); the pessimistic band (Δmain = 20% of eliminated tqkv) covered all four shapes (5.1-6.7% vs measured 5.4-7.2%). Aux-kernel elimination remains the highest-certainty lever family on this operator; for future waves the pessimistic band alone is a sufficient go/no-go estimator when the aux TaskDur share is measured.
